status: Measured licensed phone-photo holdout benchmark with completed semantic adjudication

dataset.name: SNAPMe
dataset.limitation: Licensed external phone photos, not owned product captures; visible identity only; no post-holdout tuning.

configuration.grading: strict normalized exact label or pre-approved alias match

semantic_adjudication.policy: One-to-one human judgment against independently reviewed visible labels. Only MATCH counts as correct; a visible label cannot be reused within a case.

interpretation: Strict lexical F1 was 0.371. Completed one-to-one adjudication of all 21 non-exact predictions produced semantic precision 0.853, recall 0.806, and F1 0.829. This remains recognition-only evidence on 10 licensed external phone photos, not end-to-end nutrition or product-specific validation.
